Subject: AWS marketplace payout: holdback / VAT nexus in DE?

Hi Marissa,

FYI — our payments team flagged a 15% holdback on the Jan AWS Marketplace payout that was routed via your EU seller entity. The note from the marketplace references potential VAT nexus for Acme in DE (they've put a temporary withholding while they validate).

Can Redwood provide: 1) a succinct ledger extract showing the invoice lines billed to Acme for Dec/Jan, 2) any prior VAT registration evidence that we can share with AWS to expedite release, and 3) an estimate of timing if the hold remains? AWS asked us to send evidence this week.

Attaching the notification we received from AWS and our payout summary. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks —
Leah

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Leah Dunn <leah.dunn@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jan 2028 12:18:00 +0000
Subject: ACTION: Acme payout holdback — need ledger extract + VAT proof for AWS case

Team —

Acme (Acme Analytics) received a 15% holdback from AWS for Jan payouts citing possible VAT nexus in Germany. Leah copied above. AWS asked for evidence to validate seller tax status. We need:

- Karthik: a compact ledger extract (CSV) that includes invoice id, marketplace transaction id, billing country, VAT charged, gross amount, marketplace fees, and payout line for Dec 2027 + Jan 2028. Prefer ISO timestamps. Mark any lines that show EU VAT collected.
- Jonas: pull any past VAT registration docs or reciprocal evidence we have for the EU entity that handled Acme's listing (sales tax registration, VAT registration number, EORI if available). If there are earlier correspondence threads where AWS accepted these docs, include them.

Deadline: Leah said AWS wants evidence this week — can we target EOD tomorrow (24 Jan) for a bundle? Leah, Acme prefers a single zip with a short README.

Notes: Acme uses account code ACME-2384 in HubSpot. Attach redwood_withholding_playbook_v1.pdf as internal guidance on common holdback responses.

Thanks — this is priority. If you hit blockers, escalate to Legal immediately.

Marissa

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Leah Dunn <leah.dunn@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jan 2028 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: ACTION: Acme payout holdback — ledger extract + VAT proof (bundle attached)

Marissa / Jonas / Leah —

Attached is the ledger extract (aws-ledger-snippet.csv) covering 2027-12-01 to 2028-01-31 with the fields Marissa requested. I flagged rows where VAT was applied and included marketplace transaction IDs.

Also included in the bundle: acme_evidence_bundle.zip which contains the seller VAT certificate (EU-VAT-ACME-2019.pdf), prior AWS acceptance email (aws_acceptance_2024-08-02.eml), and a short README that maps invoice IDs to payout lines.

Preliminary timing note: once AWS gets these docs they usually clear the hold within 24–72 hours when the seller registration is straightforward. If AWS says they need additional corporate proof (e.g., German tax registration), we'll need Acme to provide that — we can share the bundle directly to the AWS case if you authorize.

Leah — please confirm whether you'd like Redwood to upload directly to the AWS case or have you submit.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Billing Ops — Redwood Inference

Thanks for confirming earlier. Per Karthik, we uploaded the evidence pack to your HubSpot file folder and are ready to post to the AWS case on your behalf if you provide the case ID or explicit consent to act. Proposed next steps: 

1) Acme confirms: OK for Redwood to upload to AWS case ID #AWS-842711 (if this is the case ID you referenced).
2) If OK, Redwood will: a) submit the bundle directly to AWS, b) request expedited review, and c) notify you when AWS marks the case updated/closed.
3) If Acme prefers to submit, use the attached README which maps files to the specific invoice/payout lines.
